In the modern luxury market, brand equity is no longer built solely on the product—it is sustained through immersive experiences. Nowhere is this strategy more apparent than at the Porsche Experience Center in Atlanta, where high-octane engineering meets intentional culinary artistry. 

Restaurant 356's Executive Chef Kristol Bryant shares how she is translating Porsche’s legendary philosophy of craftsmanship, innovation, and a relentless pursuit of quality onto the plate. For Chef Bryant, culinary art is the ultimate equalizer and relationship builder. Now, she is bringing that deeply grounded emotional connection to an elevated, high-performance environment where guests can watch a Porsche take a corner at speed while enjoying a menu that is thoughtful, seasonal, and technique-driven.
